invalidation.dependents: 以已使用 datum ID 與 digest 對應正在進行的任務及衍生資料

social_evidence.identity_digest: sha256 of canonical JSON {platform,identity:platform_id or url}
social_evidence.confirmation_evidence: Original conversation or approved_document excerpt, source, retrieved_at, brand scope and sha256 of the excerpt

coverage_requirements.transcript: transcript with language, origin and start/end timecodes
coverage_requirements.audiovisual: audiovisual_analysis with reader, audio/visual modes, timecodes and receipt

social_evidence.search_candidates: Host searches and reads original discovery evidence, then calls brand_sources_add; candidate still needs user confirmation
social_evidence.review_evidence_digest: sha256 of the approved full evidence JSON with recursively sorted object keys; task evidence must match the approved digest
